candidates.structural_interaction: Water directing Fire cross-polarity — depth shaping illumination into structured purpose
candidates.k2_overview: Your Fire moves as the Steward: a hearth, not a bonfire. You keep warmth the way households keep flame, fed regularly, banked at night, never wasted on show. Your providing glows: steady income, warm table, festivals on schedule. It is the rarest fire, the kind that lasts.

k2_functional.mind: You think in fuel budgets: what sustains the warmth, what merely burns it.
k2_functional.expression: You promise warmly and deliver on time. Your word keeps people warm.
k2_functional.bonds: You tend relationships like a stove: daily fuel, steady heat, no cold mornings.
k2_functional.action: You work in sustainable heat: consistent output that never needs rescue.
k2_functional.body: Your energy is banked flame: protected sleep, regular meals, celebration in season.

k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is hearth-warm: earned brightly, spent on the household’s glow, kept steady over spectacular. Fund the gatherings and the securities both. A warm home is your portfolio’s purpose.
k2_domain_readings.Savings: You save for warmth: reserves that keep winters kind. Automate them so celebration cannot raid the woodpile. A banked fire relights fast. An empty grate does not.
k2_domain_readings.Steady love: You love like kept flame: daily warmth, faithful attention, romance on the calendar and off it. Your constancy is the gift. Add sparks deliberately so the hearth never assumes.
